name: Even in Eagan 2026
information: ### There is no 3x3 at this competition and it is held on a *Friday evening* ##### This competition is **not recommended** for new competitors. It will only host 4x4, 6x6, and Square-1 solving. [Click here for other upcoming Minnesota competitions.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?search=minnesota) ##### ____________________________________ Only 1 guest per competitor is allowed to enter the room to ensure we have enough space.
